EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION


Sunshine Act Meetings

FEDERAL REGISTER CITATION OF PREVIOUS ANNOUNCEMENT: 91 FR 51491.

PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED TIME AND DATE OF THE MEETING: Tuesday, August 11, 
2026, 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time or earlier.

CHANGES IN THE MEETING: This notice announces that the meeting was 
cancelled. On August 10, 2026, the EEOC published a notice in the 
Federal Register, 91 FR 51491, announcing closed meeting of the 
Commission to consider the following matters: Pending Litigation 
Matter(s). The meeting was to be held on August 11, 2026, at EEOC 
Headquarters, Jacqueline A. Berrien Training Center, 131 M Street NE, 
Washington, DC 20507. The matters to be considered were decided by the 
Commissioners by notation vote pursuant to Commission voting 
procedures. Thus, the meeting became unnecessary.

CONTACT PERSON FOR MORE INFORMATION: Raymond Windmiller, Executive 
Officer, (202) 921-2705.

    Dated: August 11, 2026.

    For the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission.
Raymond D. Windmiller,
Executive Officer, Office of the Executive Secretariat.
[FR Doc. 2026-16543 Filed 8-11-26; 4:15 pm]
BILLING CODE 6570-01-P
